info.name: CareerHub API tests
info.description: Run with the Postman Collection Runner, top to bottom, ONE iteration. Requires the backend on port 5000 and seeded demo data (npm run seed). Postman keeps the auth cookie between requests, so the folders log in as different users in order. The run leaves seed data untouched; it only adds a few registered test users.

item.name: 1. Public endpoints and error handling (no login)
Logout (clears any old cookie, starts a fresh run)

exec: const f = new Date(); f.setUTCDate(f.getUTCDate() + 14); pm.collectionVariables.set('futureDate', f.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
const p = new Date(); p.setUTCDate(p.getUTCDate() - 3); pm.collectionVariables.set('pastDate', p.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
pm.test("data is an array and meta has pagination", function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(json.meta).to.have.keys("total", "page", "limit", "totalPages"); });
pm.test("only open internships are listed", function () { json.data.forEach(function (i) { pm.expect(i.isOpen).to.eql(true); }); });
pm.test("seed data is present (run: npm run seed)", function () { pm.expect(json.meta.total).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Filter by category and work mode

exec: pm.test("every result matches both filters", function () { json.data.forEach(function (i) { pm.expect(i.category).to.eql("AI/ML"); pm.expect(i.workMode).to.eql("Remote"); }); });

item.name: Page size above the maximum is rejected

exec: pm.test("Message mentions: invalid id", function () { pm.expect(json.message.toLowerCase()).to.include("invalid id"); });
pm.test("Message mentions: malformed json", function () { pm.expect(json.message.toLowerCase()).to.include("malformed json"); });
pm.test("role is student and no password hash is returned", function () { pm.expect(json.data.user.role).to.eql("student"); pm.expect(json.data.user).to.not.have.property("password"); });

pm.test("auth cookie is HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax", function () { var c = pm.response.headers.get("Set-Cookie") || ""; pm.expect(c).to.include("careerhub_token"); pm.expect(c).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(c).to.include("SameSite=Lax"); });
pm.test("Message mentions: already exists", function () { pm.expect(json.message.toLowerCase()).to.include("already exists"); });
pm.test("errors list names the password field", function () { pm.expect(json.errors[0].field).to.eql("password"); });
